note: Used only by rules naming a calendar, and only for the years listed. Outside them a rule counts weekends only and says so, which gives an earlier date. Maintained by hand: a person must add each new year.

NY.authority: 11 NYCRR 216.1 excludes New York State legal holidays from business days; the list is General Construction Law § 24.

TX.authority: Tex. Ins. Code § 542.051(1): a business day is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday recognized by this state.
